newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: EARLY BOOKOVER DEALS BOOST SAPPI VOLUMES.
newsitem.headline: EARLY BOOKOVER DEALS BOOST SAPPI VOLUMES.

text.p: Early bookover deals boosted trade in South African pulp and paper producer Sappi Ltd, dealers said on Thursday.

They said several large bookovers, where one broker finds both buyer and seller, saw volumes jump by 0750 GMT to 864,100 shares traded worth more than 41 million rand -- making it by far the biggest early feature on the bourse.
"It is just bookover deals. Sappi is usually quite a busy stock," one dealer said.
The firm's share price rose 25 cents to a new year high of 48.50 rand. The stock has been riding high recently after the announcement of its half year results earlier this month.
The firm posted a dismal set of numbers, but the market perception is that the pulp and paper cycle has turned and the group is set for strong positive growth in the future.
On June 2 the stock was trading as low as 39.00 rand.
